threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
An accidental fire at the Bhiwandi warehouse resulted in the loss of inventory and certain fixed assets.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "On 25th November 2025, an accidental fire resulted in the loss of inventory and certain fixed assets stored at that location." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

threats.point: The carrying value of the inventory at the Bhiwandi warehouse was approximately Rs.21.85 crores.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Yes, so the carrying value of the inventory at our warehouse in Bhiwandi has been disclosed in the notes to account at Rs.21.85 crores approximately." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S2/W15/O22/T17), led by 'Management targets EBITDA margins between 12% to 15% at any point in time', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
